naval_weapon_system.mounts[] instantiates only 1 of the 4 HHQ-10 launchers and 1 of the 4 Type 1130 CIWS mounts as functional ciws-type mounts, per the DDG-51 template's per-mount-representative convention (that record likewise instantiates only 1 of DDG-81's 2 Phalanx mounts). The remaining 3 of each are documented in _real_world.weapon_inventory with representative_load figures, not separately instantiated as duplicate mount_ids, since the task's mount rules do not require one mount_id per physical launcher.
No gun_5in mount: Fujian carries no main gun per OOB (point-defense missiles and CIWS only, consistent with a large carrier hull prioritizing flight-deck space).

Fixed-wing air wing (J-35/J-15T/J-15D-DT/KJ-600/GJ-21) is documented only in _real_world per the task's carrier-specific instructions; the engine's embarked_air_ops schema supports only a single referenced helo unit and has no mechanism for fixed-wing carrier aviation, consistent with how the US Ford-class carrier record (if any) would need to handle the same schema limitation. This record follows the task's explicit instruction to reference MH-60R_MVP as a Z-20F placeholder only.

Anti-torpedo/anti-swimmer/122mm rocket launchers (IDSA, B-sourcing-quality forum-derived list) have no NavalWeaponType mount and are documented only as damage_model.hitboxes components, not in weapon_inventory, since they are point-defense/countermeasure systems rather than offensive weapons with Missile records in this packet's scope.

4-hitbox zoning (bow catapults/flight deck, island/radar/command, waist catapult/hangar/aviation fuel, aft propulsion/torpedo defense) chosen to give each major real system its own damageable zone per task instruction, following the DDG-51/T-AOE-6 templates' pattern scaled up for a much larger hull.
